name: openclaude-antigravity-provider
description: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy that authenticates via Google Antigravity OAuth, enabling OpenClaude to use Claude Opus/Sonnet and Gemini models with your Google credentials.

scripts.build: bun build --compile src/server.ts --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile bin/antigravity-proxy-win-x64.exe && bun build --compile src/server.ts --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/antigravity-proxy-linux-x64 && bun build --compile src/server.ts --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile bin/antigravity-proxy-linux-arm64 && bun build --compile src/server.ts --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile bin/antigravity-proxy-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile src/server.ts --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile bin/antigravity-proxy-darwin-arm64
